name: Canadian French voice-rating and speech data tasks
summary: Short online projects where native Canadian French speakers located in Canada rate computer-generated voices or audio for AI training through Appen's CrowdGen platform.
whatYouDo: After applying to a specific project and setting up a CrowdGen account, you listen to pairs of synthetic (text-to-speech) clips in Canadian French and judge which sounds more natural, or rate voice quality. Projects are temporary and pay per task, with rates sent in kickoff emails.
appeal: Postings specifically seek native Canadian French speakers currently located in Canada
Work from home in short tasks
Payouts by bank transfer, PayPal, Payoneer or Airtm depending on location
watchOuts: Postings warn high work volumes are not guaranteed; listed pay is a placeholder ($0.01–$1 per task) with real rates only in kickoff emails
Worker reviews (Trustpilot, Dec 2025) report onboarding then no work, and a payment that took two months
Projects can end without notice and some qualification assessments are reportedly unpaid
No general signup: you apply project by project
No Canadian French voice-recording (as opposed to rating) project was found

training.notes: Project-specific guidelines and qualifications; some reportedly unpaid. Chrome browser recommended.

compensation.notes: fr-CA postings show placeholder rates ($1/task; $0.01 piece rate); actual rates come in kickoff emails. Homepage advertises top rates of $100+/hour depending on location and skills, which is not representative of these tasks.

reliability.notes: Official posting says high volumes not guaranteed; worker reviews report long waits for work after onboarding and projects ending without notice.

applicationSteps: Find a current Canadian French project on Appen's CrowdGen job board (jobs.lever.co/appen)
Follow the emailed instructions to create a CrowdGen account
Do tasks when available and withdraw earnings
fitsIf: You are a native Canadian French speaker living in Canada who wants occasional small online tasks and doesn't depend on the income.
notFitIf: You need predictable work or income, or dislike unpaid qualification steps.

sources.title: CrowdGen by Appen - Where expert contributors shape frontier AI
sources.notes: Appen's contributor platform (Appen listed on ASX as APX); apply to specific projects; never asks you to pay; top pay '$100+/h' depending on location and skills; withdrawals via bank transfer, PayPal, Payoneer, Airtm by location.
